config.name: paper
config.model: u=h*z+e; z~CN(0,q), e~CN(0,sI); latent z and h unavailable to estimator
config.prior: Uniform on all native complex lines; not restricted to the ULA angle curve
config.validation: Independent trajectories; expected true output power selects each family/horizon. Mean, same-A mode and matched isotropization share the selected mean memory. EW PCA, scalar regularization, loaded covariance and GROUSE are selected separately.
config.stationary: beta=1 fixed for Haar and stationary ULA; uniform ambient complex-line prior
config.moving: Identity transport; each family selects memory from validation, not the true angle path.
config.scalar: rho*P+(1-rho)I/n, optimized continuously on independent validation, separately from per-posterior matched isotropization
config.statistics: Strict trajectory-level paired Student intervals; all snapshots, queries and posterior draws within a trajectory are not independent replications.
config.tail_scope: Exact iid native-complex samples; sample quantiles and independent mass/CDF checks are Monte Carlo approximations, not deterministic tail certificates.
config.primary: Complete SNR/snapshot decision map; comparisons are pointwise exploratory, without choosing a winning test regime.

gate.scope: Complete general notebook and regression suite; empirical and numerical study flags have separate scopes

checks.numerical_status: All flags retained; iid tail checks and mean truncation have different error scopes
